g.text: Monorepo — platform permission and serialized role changes
Dev principal configured or matching operator token?
Deny platform authorization through browser fallback
SetRole validates requested role; opens DB transaction
Recheck actor remains administrator within transaction
Require target user exists; read previous role
Require more than one current administrator
Delete role or upsert new role
Insert event with previous/new role and actor or installation-credential
Commit role and audit event together
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete platform store and policy reviewed. DevPrincipalActive makes
HasCredential return true before token comparison, irrespective of supplied credentials;
tenant resolution has a narrower no-credential dev fallback. Operator token comparison is
fixed-time after equal-length check. Platform roles and workspace membership are separate
tables/decisions; this is not semantic evidence standing.
